a.lede: A number of tech figures want the board of the AI chip giant to give Jensen Huang his job back.
a.title: Trump backs return of ex-Nvidia boss after 'Bring Jensen Back' campaign launched

b.lede: An internal post urging the board to consider employee sentiment about Nvidia’s former CEO has drawn more than 1,600 comments, the majority in full support of reinstalling him.
b.title: ‘Bring Back THE Boss’: Nvidia Employees Petition for Jensen Huang’s Return
